facts.text: I am working on a thesis about AI in healthcare.
I need help finding relevant articles on deep learning applications in cancer diagnosis.
I sent out 50 survey requests to medical professionals to gather their opinions on the current state of AI in healthcare.
I am interested in exploring the application of deep learning in cancer diagnosis.
I am specifically interested in deep learning for cancer diagnosis using medical imaging.
I want insights on how to get started building a deep learning model for medical image analysis.
I am interested in key considerations and best practices for building a deep learning model for medical image analysis.
I am interested in the data preprocessing step for medical image analysis.
I want information on data augmentation techniques to increase the size and diversity of a medical imaging dataset.
I want more information on how to implement data augmentation techniques in PyTorch.
I want examples of how to use the Albumentations library for data augmentation.
I provided additional Albumentations examples including Random rotation with A.Rotate(limit=30, p=0.5).
I provided additional Albumentations examples including RandomBrightnessContrast with brightness_limit=0.2, contrast_limit=0.2, p=0.5.
I provided additional Albumentations examples including Gaussian blur with blur_limit=5, p=0.5.
I provided additional Albumentations examples including GridDistortion with num_steps=5, distort_limit=0.3, p=0.5.
